At the National IIMUN Conference, it was a pleasure interacting with 500+ school and college teachers from across India. One big challenge came through clearly: how do we get young people to separate news from noise?
AI and social media have created a generation constantly connected to screens, but not necessarily to the world around them. How do we promote news literacy, encourage curiosity about current affairs and help children navigate an information overload?
There are no easy answers—but plenty of opportunities. A fascinating exchange of ideas with those on the frontlines of educating India’s next generation. Will share a video soon.
